OpenSkiMapStatus.description:
Operating status of a run, ski area, or lift according to OpenSkiMap.
Null values can arise for elements without an OSM source. "
See OpenSkiMap processing code at
<https://github.com/russellporter/openskidata-processor/blob/bc168105f4d90c19817189ebe47e7bee20a2dcbc/src/transforms/Status.ts#L3-L8>.
OpenSkiMapStatus.title: OpenSkiMapStatus

RunDifficultyConvention.description:
Convention for the ski run difficulty coloring.
See <https://github.com/russellporter/openskidata-format/blob/e421ef0a0814437c362611e07cb43c32bac4172c/src/Run.ts#L113>.
RunDifficultyConvention.title: RunDifficultyConvention

record_schema.description: Curated ski-area properties and metrics for public use.

ski_area_id.description: Unique OpenSkiMap identifier for a ski area.
ski_area_id.title: Ski Area Id

osm_status.description: Operating status of the ski area according to OpenSkiMap. Null values arise for ski areas without an OSM source in ski_area_sources. See OpenSkiMap processing code at <https://github.com/russellporter/openskidata-processor/blob/bc168105f4d90c19817189ebe47e7bee20a2dcbc/src/transforms/Status.ts#L3-L8>.

osm_run_convention.description: OpenSkiMap difficulty convention that determines how runs are colored.

ski_area_uses.description: OpenSkiMap usage types / activities for the ski area.
ski_area_uses.title: Ski Area Uses

country.description: Country where the ski area is located.
country.title: Country

country_subdiv_code.description: ISO 3166-2 code for principal subdivision (e.g., province or state) of the country.
country_subdiv_code.title: Country Subdiv Code

region.description: Region/subdivision/province/state where the ski area is located.
region.title: Region

locality.description: Locality/town/city where the ski area is located.
locality.title: Locality

latitude.description: Latitude of the ski area in decimal degrees. Latitude measures the distance north (positive values) or south (negative values) of the equator.
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: Longitude of the ski area in decimal degrees. Longitude measures the distance east (positive values) or west (negative values) of the prime meridian.
longitude.title: Longitude

ski_area_websites.description: List of URLs for the ski area.
ski_area_websites.title: Ski Area Websites

ski_area_sources.description: List of sources for the ski area from OpenSkiMap.
ski_area_sources.title: Ski Area Sources

wikidata_id.description: Wikidata identifier for the ski area. See <https://github.com/dhimmel/openskistats/issues/10> and <https://github.com/russellporter/openskimap.org/issues/153>.
wikidata_id.title: Wikidata Id

run_count.description: Number of downhill runs in the ski area with supported geometries.
run_count.title: Run Count

combined_vertical.description: Total combined vertical drop of the ski area in meters. If you skied every run in the ski area exactly once, this is the total vertical drop you would accumulate.
combined_vertical.title: Combined Vertical

combined_distance.description: Total distance of the ski area's runs in meters. If you skied every run in the ski area exactly once, this is the total distance you would accumulate.
combined_distance.title: Combined Distance

vertical_drop.description: Vertical drop of the ski area in meters. Vertical drop is the difference in elevation between the highest and lowest points of the ski area's runs.
vertical_drop.title: Vertical Drop

min_elevation.description: Base elevation of the ski area in meters computed as the lowest elevation along all runs.
min_elevation.title: Min Elevation

max_elevation.description: Peak elevation of the ski area in meters computed as the highest elevation along all runs.
max_elevation.title: Max Elevation

solar_irradiation_season.description: Average daily solar irradiation received by run segments over the course of a typical 121 day ski season in kilowatt-hours per square meter (kW/m²/day). The average is weighted by the vertical drop of each segment. This value measures solar irradiation by treating each run segment as a plane according to its latitude, longitude, elevation, bearing, and slope. Solar irradiance is computed using clear sky estimates for diffuse normal irradiance, global horizontal irradiance, and direct horizontal irradiance according to the Ineichen and Perez model with Linke turbidity.
solar_irradiation_season.title: Solar Irradiation Season

bearing_alignment.description: Bearing alignment score, representing the concentration / consistency / cohesion of the bearings.
bearing_alignment.title: Bearing Alignment

poleward_affinity.description: The poleward affinity, representing the tendency of bearings to cluster towards the neatest pole (1.0) or equator (-1.0). Positive values indicate bearings cluster towards the pole of the hemisphere in which the ski area is located. Negative values indicate bearings cluster towards the equator.
poleward_affinity.title: Poleward Affinity

eastward_affinity.description: The eastern affinity, representing the tendency of bearings to cluster towards the east (1.0) or west (-1.0). Positive values indicate bearings cluster towards the east. Negative values indicate bearings cluster towards the west.
eastward_affinity.title: Eastward Affinity

run_proportion_4_north.description: Proportion of vertical-drop-weighted run segments facing north in a four-cardinal-direction partition.
run_proportion_4_north.title: Run Proportion 4 North

run_proportion_4_east.description: Proportion of vertical-drop-weighted run segments facing east in a four-cardinal-direction partition.
run_proportion_4_east.title: Run Proportion 4 East

run_proportion_4_south.description: Proportion of vertical-drop-weighted run segments facing south in a four-cardinal-direction partition.
run_proportion_4_south.title: Run Proportion 4 South

run_proportion_4_west.description: Proportion of vertical-drop-weighted run segments facing west in a four-cardinal-direction partition.
run_proportion_4_west.title: Run Proportion 4 West

run_proportion_2_north.description: Proportion of vertical-drop-weighted run segments facing north rather than south in a two-direction partition.
run_proportion_2_north.title: Run Proportion 2 North

record_schema.title: SkiAreaSummary
